description.p: A way into research for people without university logins: Scholar-style search across OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, arXiv and Crossref; a daily Discover feed of research and news; and AI-written, fully cited articles built from real sources you can click through.
Every passage is marked as original text, AI-reworded original, or AI-written. Papers with only a free abstract get a clearly labelled AI interpretation that always links to the real paper.
